title: Exactly what I wanted
review_text: The wide-leg cut is flattering and the blush pink is softer than it looks online, in a good way. I picked it up at T Nagar and the bag was ready the moment I walked in. Good quality denim for the price.

title: Gachibowli again
review_text: Third time I have had to wait more than two hours at Gachibowli for a pickup that was supposed to be ready in two. The shirt is fine but this store keeps missing the promise. Please fix it or stop advertising it.

title: Size chart galat hai
review_text: Size chart ke hisaab se 28 order kiya tha lekin waist bahut tight hai. Store me exchange ho gaya par time waste hua. Please chart sahi karo.

title: Staff went the extra mile
review_text: I came in ten minutes before closing and the Banjara Hills team still brought my order out, helped me try it and even ironed the kurta. Great attitude. The kurta itself is sharp and comfortable.

title: Decent but pricey
review_text: The jacket is well made and the colour is nice, but I think it is a bit expensive compared to similar ones elsewhere. Not a bad purchase, just not a bargain.

title: Wow, loved paying full price
review_text: Wow, loved discovering that the website discount did not exist at the counter. Great job making me feel special, Threadhouse. Will definitely not recommend this to anyone.

title: Payment page stuck again
review_text: Tried Pay online, the page froze at the last step and I was charged by my bank but no order shows up. I called the number on the website and nobody picked up. I need this sorted urgently.

title: Great shirt, slow checkout
review_text: The shirt is fantastic and exactly as described. The pickup staff at Koramangala were quick. The checkout on the site was slow though and took almost a minute to confirm.
